title: Trade unions leader calls on Labour to forge closer relationship with Europe
summary: In an exclusive interview, the head of the TUC Paul Nowak says a customs union with the EU could boost the UK’s economy Keir Starmer should seek out a far closer relationship with Europe, including a possible customs union, the head of the TUC has said. Paul Nowak, TUC general secretary, said the British public recognised the need for a vastly improved trading arrangement and said it had become more urgent than ever because of the fickle nature of the relationship with Donald Trump’s United States. title: Key Bolsonaro ally arrested in Paraguay while trying to flee to El Salvador
